premises.text: The non-profit sector is underserved by technology and relies on outdated processes
premises.evidence_span: non-profits continue to be underserved by our tech community. Many still rely on pen and paper for core processes like scheduling, volunteer tracking, and even donations.

premises.text: Volunteers are more likely to donate and donate more than non-volunteers
premises.evidence_span: volunteers not only give 6.9 billion hours of service each year, they are also twice as likely to donate and donate 10 times more than non-volunteers.

premises.text: CivicChamps provides automated volunteer management through multiple tracking methods
premises.evidence_span: CivicChamps provides automated volunteer management by providing three different ways for non-profits to track volunteer hours.

premises.text: The platform can convert volunteers to donors through an integrated micro-donations feature
premises.evidence_span: we're excited to launch the integrated micro-donations platform that will allow for non-profits to automatically convert volunteers to donors.

premises.text: Volunteer data can inform non-profits on donor engagement strategies
premises.evidence_span: By leveraging our volunteer data, we can tell non-profits when to give, how much they give, and what to say.

premises.text: CivicChamps has a unique technology architecture for seamless data sharing among non-profits, volunteers, and corporations
premises.evidence_span: Civic Champs has a database and technology architecture that's uniquely built to serve the full market, allowing for seamless data sharing between non-profits, volunteers, and corporations.

premises.text: CivicChamps targets a growing CRM market for non-profits
premises.evidence_span: Civic Champs is targeting the $1.7 billion CRM market for non-profits. This grows to $6.3 billion as we add additional features, and $20 billion as we look at adjacent industries such as corporate social responsibility, political campaigns, and donation processing.

value.text: Non-profits can manage volunteers efficiently and convert them into donors
value.evidence_span: seamless volunteer management in a way to automatically convert your volunteers to donors

notes: Competitor analysis and team background excluded as traction.
